milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The agent must navigate near the pumpkin cluster center at (4,0,3) and face it, confirming visual identification. max_distance=8 allows detection when the agent is looking at the pumpkins from a reasonable viewing distance.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The agent must navigate close enough to the village center at (15,0,15) and face it, confirming they have found and are observing the village structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing with tight distance (max_distance=2) because the valid rule types don't include a direct 'use_item_on_block' check. Being within 2 blocks and facing the crafting table at (15,0,15) is the strongest available proxy for interaction — the agent must be standing directly adjacent to it and looking at it.
